title: Trust in Relationships
summary: Trust is confidence that a partner is honest, reliable and has your interests at heart. It grows through consistency — doing what you say — and can be rebuilt slowly after a breach.
key_points: Trust issues often come from past hurt, not only the current partner.
Transparency helps; surveillance doesn't build trust.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
